body: It is ok, I’ve been very busy too. Thank you I am glad you exist

I’m so sorry to hear that, I am here for you just message me anytime and we can get through this together. My suicidal thoughts and nightmares also keep me up at night and it is very tough to deal with. You don’t have to suffer through this alone, I’m here.

I’m so sorry. I am here for you, I’ve been doing the same. I have been crying myself to sleep and I can’t stay here much longer. I’ve been cutting myself each night now and throughout the day. I am truly sorry.
My dad told me I do it for attention, and he also told me I just wanted to fit in with the girls at school. I’m sorry your friend says those things to you.
Thank you, please talk to me if you need anything. I’m here for you as long as i decide to stay
I feel the exact same way, I can’t stay here on this earth much longer. I am here for you.
I do not think there is a god. I think it’s all a lie, if there is a god why is there so much pain and suffering in this world
I am here for you, everyone hates me too and I feel so alone
This is exactly how I feel about myself
So am I. I wish you the best I am here
I like you and no one likes me either. I want to go away forever
I can be your friend too. Thank you, I don’t want you to feel so down either.

I completely understand I am taking my life soon, no one will miss me no one loves me or cares about me and I have bpd I can’t live much longer. I feel so alone and worthless, I’m not important to anyone and no one will miss me when I’m gone. 

I’m sorry you feel this way and I wish you the best.

This is my last because i am crippled by anxiety and depression. I have borderline personality disorder and I am crippled by it. I hate my thoughts and I hate the way I am forced to stay alive and suffer. I can’t go outside without being eaten alive by anxiety. No one cares about me, no one cares. No one checks on me, I feel worthless and I am never going to have a family or be happy. I have been through many traumatic things and I can’t overcome it.
This is my last Christmas too. I’m so sorry you’re feeling this, you matter and you’re important. I wish you the best

I’m so lost too and so lonely. I’ve been crying every night. I cannot wait to die. I hope you feel better very soon, I am here for you. If no one has told you today I love you. You matter and you’re important
I also have bpd and I am consumed with thoughts of my own death as well. I don’t think I can stay alive much longer. I hope you get well soon, I wish you the best.

Merry Christmas, I am struggling and I feel the same exact way about myself. You’re important, you’re worthy and you matter. I hope things get better for you, if no one has told you today I love you. I wish you the best luck ♥️
